summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Ripple Golf Charity Platform. All requested features are working correctly: Ripple branding across all pages, theme toggle (light/dark), charity selection displaying on dashboard, and theme persistence via localStorage.
passed_tests: Landing page loads with 'Ripple' branding (concentric circles logo + 'Ripple' text)
Theme toggle button in navbar switches between light and dark mode
Light mode: cards are white, text is dark, page background is light
Dark mode: cards are dark, text is light, page background is dark
Login flow works with admin@golfcharity.com / Admin@2024!
After login, dashboard shows correct user data
Charity selection: navigate to /charities, select a charity, verify it appears on dashboard
Dashboard charity card shows selected charity name and contribution percentage
Theme persists after page navigation (stored in localStorage)
Charities page renders all 6 charities with proper theme-aware colors
Backend API: 16/16 tests passed (auth, charities, user profile, subscription)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from the bug fix are working: 1) ThemeProvider wraps entire app including preloader - no more crash, 2) Charity display on dashboard works correctly - shows selected charity name and contribution %, 3) Light/Dark theme toggle works with localStorage persistence, 4) 'Ripple' branding is consistent across all pages (Landing, Login, Register, Dashboard, Charities, Preloader). The 401 console errors are expected for unauthenticated API calls to /api/auth/me.
